structure.layout: Single-screen kiosk welcome page: dark green top bar with brand and two buttons; two-column main with left search hero + 2x2 quick-start card grid, right aside with featured exhibit card and a fact card

aesthetics.typography: Georgia serif for H1 (52px/600), H2 (22px), featured title (26px) and large card counts (30px); system-ui sans for body, buttons, card titles and descriptions; Courier New in the SVG specimen label
aesthetics.typeScale: Strong contrast: 52px serif display headline vs 17-18px body, 14px card descriptions, 13px letter-spaced uppercase eyebrows; 30px serif numerals anchor each card

notes: Touch-kiosk welcome screen styled like a natural-history museum: parchment cream background, forest-green header and primary button, serif display type. Large touch targets (48-60px buttons, whole-card buttons). Quick-start cards are canned queries showing result counts in large serif numerals with an arrow. Featured exhibit card contains a hand-drawn SVG herbarium sheet (pressed stem, tape corners, label box). Footnote explains 3-minute idle reset. No shadows; thin #d8d1bd outlines; 10-14px radii. Codebook lacks a 'quick-start/canned query shortcut' pattern; coded as cards.
